source.attribution: NeqSim 3.20.0, SystemPrEos with the matching AttractiveTerm* - the upstream this library is a port of, run from validation/neqsim/FlashTp.java
source.notes: Mathias-Copeman on Peng-Robinson, three fitted parameters from the `mcpr1..3` columns; above the critical temperature it falls back to the base Soave form. NeqSim's hardcoded water/TEG overrides are not ported - azoth reads the databank columns for every substance.

derivation:
The driver was run for methane 0.6 / n-butane 0.4 at 330 K and 25 bar on SystemPrEos with `setAttractiveTerm(13)`. NeqSim printed:

  beta 0.8433573916547272
  k    [7.295657476424182, 0.3384006329637498]
  x    [0.0950948602189571, 0.9049051397810428]
  y    [0.6937795279259453, 0.3062204720740547]
  Zl   0.0931920882237041
  Zv   0.8683284583490157

azoth reproduces all six to the same residue the other cubic cases show.
